<a id="overview"></a>

## Overview

Definitions, memory and outputs are ddocs on the governance branch, written by one daemon-side writer through the ddocs CLI. The store holds pointers and live state (assignments, lineage, requests), and can be rebuilt from the branch. Delivery learns one new address form, `role:<id>`, and one new request field, the reply mode. Product docs (PRDs, blueprints, roadmaps) live on main under docs/project and are joined by ddocs links.

<a id="decisions"></a>

## Decisions

| id | decision | why | realises |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| d-6 | Memory is kept forever, one note per file, with a generated index. | Memory is the community's knowledge and storage is cheap; small files and an index let a seat read only what it needs and never conflict. | [req-09](../prds/001-pij-community.dd.md#requirements) |
| d-7 | One standard docs layout by type, every file NNN. | Blueprints are shared across many PRDs, so they cannot live in one PRD's folder; one layout everywhere is easier for agents than a per-project setting. | [req-18](../prds/001-pij-community.dd.md#requirements) |
| d-1 | Directory files on the governance branch; product docs on main. | Running the fleet is governance; what the product needs ships with its code, so a builder flips a requirement in the PR that delivers it. | [req-02](../prds/001-pij-community.dd.md#requirements), [req-18](../prds/001-pij-community.dd.md#requirements) |
| d-2 | Use the ddocs CLI from pij-rs; no Rust port. | ddocs is TypeScript only. Writes are rare, so two launches per write are cheap. flowspace3's Rust parser is read-only and stays an option. | [req-03](../prds/001-pij-community.dd.md#requirements) |
| d-3 | One file per output. | Shared files conflict under parallel writers; one file each never does. | [req-10](../prds/001-pij-community.dd.md#requirements) |
| d-4 | pij never starts a seat on its own. | Starting a seat costs money and context; the refusal names the command instead. | [req-07](../prds/001-pij-community.dd.md#requirements) |
| d-5 | Reply mode defaults to wake. | An extra wake costs a turn; a missed one strands an idle requester. | [req-08](../prds/001-pij-community.dd.md#requirements) |
